data.narrative:
Anduril Industries is a Series H-stage Defense & Security company currently valued at $61B, having raised $11B+ across its funding rounds. The comparable universe in Defense & Security consists of 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, Quantum-Systems, and Flock Safety, totaling 10 identifiable comparables.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable in this instance due to insufficient narrow peer set resolution. Of the 22 same-sector peers identified, fewer than three companies meet simultaneous filtering criteria for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier classification. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the idiosyncratic characteristics of defense technology platforms. This constraint reflects both the capital intensity of the sector and the sparse population of late-stage, large-scale defense-tech companies that have achieved comparable scale and market positioning.

Without sufficient triangulation support from peer-median analysis, this valuation lacks a quantitatively grounded anchor point. Resolution would require either: (1) expansion of the Defense & Security comp set through identification of additional late-stage private or recently-public defense technology platforms; (2) alternative methods such as transaction multiples or DCF analysis with disclosed or inferred financial metrics; or (3) explicit acknowledgment that $61B reflects market demand and capital availability rather than derivable from traditional multiple-based frameworks. Key uncertainties center on revenue scale, customer concentration, and margin profiles relative to the sparse public comp set.
